blockers.title: Absence of Node.js Reverse Proxy for /api/*
blockers.description: Static client export has no built-in Next server rewrite proxy to forward /api/* calls to FastAPI on 127.0.0.1:5055.
blockers.impact: Requires host application (Tauri/Rust or Wails) to embed a lightweight loopback proxy or enable loopback CORS.
blockers.mitigation: Configure client-safe API host endpoint and delegate loopback proxying to native host in Section 19.

blockers.title: SPA Deep Route Dynamic Fallback
blockers.description: Refreshing dynamic routes (e.g., /notebooks/123, /notes/456) in a static web server triggers HTTP 404.
blockers.impact: Static file server must serve /index.html for all non-file client routes.
blockers.mitigation: Implement explicit SPA fallback rules in embedded native host web server (try_files $uri /index.html).

blockers.title: Server-Only Environment Variable Dependency
blockers.description: The current server relies on process.env.INTERNAL_API_URL and process.env.PORT at Node.js startup.
blockers.impact: Client-side bundle cannot access server-only process.env variables at runtime.
blockers.mitigation: Inject client-safe window.__CONFIG__ or NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL runtime configuration path.
